question: Which of our strategic accounts are at risk because of late shipments, and what should the account teams do this week?

metrics.name: deliveries_90d
metrics.label: Deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: The number of non-cancelled deliveries whose requested delivery date falls in the 90 days ending on the as-of date.

metrics.name: on_time_deliveries_90d
metrics.label: On-time deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: Of the deliveries in the 90-day window, how many the carrier delivered on or before the date the customer asked for.

metrics.name: on_time_delivery_rate
metrics.label: On-time delivery rate (90 days)
metrics.definition: The share of deliveries that arrived on or before the customer's requested date, over the last 90 days. "Arrived" is the carrier's delivered event, not a ship date; cancelled deliveries do not count; a delivery not yet delivered by its date is late.

metrics.name: late_deliveries
metrics.label: Late deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: Deliveries in the last 90 days that arrived after the requested date, or have not arrived although the date has passed.

metrics.name: net_revenue
metrics.label: Net revenue (USD)
metrics.definition: Invoiced revenue minus credit memos, converted to US dollars at the monthly average exchange rate of each billing month.

metrics.name: open_shipping_tickets
metrics.label: Open shipping tickets
metrics.definition: Open support tickets about shipping: tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics, or with a subject that mentions late, delay, shipment, delivery or tracking. Tickets on a look-alike duplicate account count toward the real customer.

metrics.name: renewals_due_120d
metrics.label: Renewals due in 120 days
metrics.definition: Open renewal opportunities that close within 120 days of the as-of date.

metrics.name: account_risk_flag
metrics.label: At-risk flag
metrics.definition: 1 when an account's on-time delivery rate is below 85% and it has two or more open shipping tickets or a renewal due in 120 days; otherwise 0. Combine with the strategic filter to get the at-risk strategic accounts.

dimensions.name: account__tier
dimensions.description: Tier at the end of the as-of date (today's tier).

dimensions.name: delivery__tier_at_delivery
dimensions.description: The customer's tier on the requested delivery date (history mode), not today's tier.

notes: Group by the entity `account` to get one row per customer, and `account__account_name` for its name.
`account__tier` is today's tier; `delivery__tier_at_delivery` is the tier in force on each delivery's date.
Delivery metrics already cover the 90 days ending on the as-of date (6 Nov 2026).

WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id AS account
    , case when is_in_90d_window then 1 else 0 end AS __deliveries_90d
    , case when is_in_90d_window and is_on_time then 1 else 0 end AS __on_time_deliveries_90d
    , case when is_in_90d_window and not is_on_time then 1 else 0 end AS __late_deliveries
  FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_delivery" deliveries_src_10000
)
, rss_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    account_name
    , region
    , tier
    , is_strategic
    , customer_id AS account
  FROM "warehouse"."marts"."dim_account" accounts_src_10000
)
, cm_10_cte AS (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , CAST(COALESCE(__on_time_deliveries_90d, 0) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COALESCE(__deliveries_90d, 0), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS on_time_delivery_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , SUM(deliveries_90d) AS __deliveries_90d
      , SUM(on_time_deliveries_90d) AS __on_time_deliveries_90d
    FROM (
      SELECT
        rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
        , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
        , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
        , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
        , sma_10001_cte.__deliveries_90d AS deliveries_90d
        , sma_10001_cte.__on_time_deliveries_90d AS on_time_deliveries_90d
      FROM sma_10001_cte
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        rss_10001_cte
      ON
        sma_10001_cte.account = rss_10001_cte.account
    ) subq_5
    WHERE account__is_strategic = true
    GROUP BY
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
  ) subq_8
)
, cm_11_cte AS (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , COALESCE(__open_shipping_tickets, 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , SUM(open_shipping_tickets) AS __open_shipping_tickets
    FROM (
      SELECT
        rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
        , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
        , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
        , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
        , subq_12.__open_shipping_tickets AS open_shipping_tickets
      FROM (
        SELECT
          customer_id AS account
          , case when is_open and is_shipping_related then 1 else 0 end AS __open_shipping_tickets
        FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_ticket" tickets_src_10000
      ) subq_12
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        rss_10001_cte
      ON
        subq_12.account = rss_10001_cte.account
    ) subq_16
    WHERE account__is_strategic = true
    GROUP BY
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
  ) subq_19
)
, cm_12_cte AS (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , COALESCE(__renewals_due_120d, 0) AS renewals_due_120d
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , SUM(renewals_due_120d) AS __renewals_due_120d
    FROM (
      SELECT
        rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
        , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
        , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
        , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
        , subq_22.__renewals_due_120d AS renewals_due_120d
      FROM (
        SELECT
          customer_id AS account
          , case when is_due_in_120d then 1 else 0 end AS __renewals_due_120d
        FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_renewal" renewals_src_10000
      ) subq_22
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        rss_10001_cte
      ON
        subq_22.account = rss_10001_cte.account
    ) subq_26
    WHERE account__is_strategic = true
    GROUP BY
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
  ) subq_29
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_32.account__account_name, subq_33.account__account_name, subq_42.account__account_name, subq_43.account__account_name, subq_44.account__account_name) AS account__account_name
  , COALESCE(subq_32.account__region, subq_33.account__region, subq_42.account__region, subq_43.account__region, subq_44.account__region) AS account__region
  , COALESCE(subq_32.account__tier, subq_33.account__tier, subq_42.account__tier, subq_43.account__tier, subq_44.account__tier) AS account__tier
  , MAX(subq_32.account_risk_flag) AS account_risk_flag
  , MAX(subq_33.on_time_delivery_rate) AS on_time_delivery_rate
  , COALESCE(MAX(subq_42.late_deliveries), 0) AS late_deliveries
  , COALESCE(MAX(subq_42.deliveries_90d), 0) AS deliveries_90d
  , COALESCE(MAX(subq_43.open_shipping_tickets), 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
  , COALESCE(MAX(subq_44.renewals_due_120d), 0) AS renewals_due_120d
FROM (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , case when on_time_delivery_rate < 0.85 and (open_shipping_tickets >= 2 or renewals_due_120d > 0) then 1 else 0 end AS account_risk_flag
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(subq_10.account__account_name, subq_20.account__account_name, subq_30.account__account_name) AS account__account_name
      , COALESCE(subq_10.account__region, subq_20.account__region, subq_30.account__region) AS account__region
      , COALESCE(subq_10.account__tier, subq_20.account__tier, subq_30.account__tier) AS account__tier
      , MAX(subq_10.on_time_delivery_rate) AS on_time_delivery_rate
      , COALESCE(MAX(subq_20.open_shipping_tickets), 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
      , COALESCE(MAX(subq_30.renewals_due_120d), 0) AS renewals_due_120d
    FROM (
      SELECT
        account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
        , on_time_delivery_rate
      FROM cm_10_cte
    ) subq_10
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT
        account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
        , open_shipping_tickets
      FROM cm_11_cte
    ) subq_20
    ON
      (
        subq_10.account__account_name = subq_20.account__account_name
      ) AND (
        subq_10.account__region = subq_20.account__region
      ) AND (
        subq_10.account__tier = subq_20.account__tier
      )
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT
        account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
        , renewals_due_120d
      FROM cm_12_cte
    ) subq_30
    ON
      (
        COALESCE(subq_10.account__account_name, subq_20.account__account_name) = subq_30.account__account_name
      ) AND (
        COALESCE(subq_10.account__region, subq_20.account__region) = subq_30.account__region
      ) AND (
        COALESCE(subq_10.account__tier, subq_20.account__tier) = subq_30.account__tier
      )
    GROUP BY
      COALESCE(subq_10.account__account_name, subq_20.account__account_name, subq_30.account__account_name)
      , COALESCE(subq_10.account__region, subq_20.account__region, subq_30.account__region)
      , COALESCE(subq_10.account__tier, subq_20.account__tier, subq_30.account__tier)
  ) subq_31
) subq_32
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , on_time_delivery_rate
  FROM cm_10_cte
) subq_33
ON
  (
    subq_32.account__account_name = subq_33.account__account_name
  ) AND (
    subq_32.account__region = subq_33.account__region
  ) AND (
    subq_32.account__tier = subq_33.account__tier
  )
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , COALESCE(__late_deliveries, 0) AS late_deliveries
    , COALESCE(__deliveries_90d, 0) AS deliveries_90d
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , SUM(deliveries_90d) AS __deliveries_90d
      , SUM(late_deliveries) AS __late_deliveries
    FROM (
      SELECT
        rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
        , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
        , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
        , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
        , sma_10001_cte.__deliveries_90d AS deliveries_90d
        , sma_10001_cte.__late_deliveries AS late_deliveries
      FROM sma_10001_cte
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        rss_10001_cte
      ON
        sma_10001_cte.account = rss_10001_cte.account
    ) subq_38
    WHERE account__is_strategic = true
    GROUP BY
      account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
  ) subq_41
) subq_42
ON
  (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__account_name, subq_33.account__account_name) = subq_42.account__account_name
  ) AND (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__region, subq_33.account__region) = subq_42.account__region
  ) AND (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__tier, subq_33.account__tier) = subq_42.account__tier
  )
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , open_shipping_tickets
  FROM cm_11_cte
) subq_43
ON
  (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__account_name, subq_33.account__account_name, subq_42.account__account_name) = subq_43.account__account_name
  ) AND (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__region, subq_33.account__region, subq_42.account__region) = subq_43.account__region
  ) AND (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__tier, subq_33.account__tier, subq_42.account__tier) = subq_43.account__tier

FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , account__region
    , account__tier
    , renewals_due_120d
  FROM cm_12_cte
) subq_44
ON
  (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__account_name, subq_33.account__account_name, subq_42.account__account_name, subq_43.account__account_name) = subq_44.account__account_name
  ) AND (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__region, subq_33.account__region, subq_42.account__region, subq_43.account__region) = subq_44.account__region
  ) AND (
    COALESCE(subq_32.account__tier, subq_33.account__tier, subq_42.account__tier, subq_43.account__tier) = subq_44.account__tier

answer.answer_summary: Nine strategic accounts are at risk: their 90-day on-time delivery rate is below 85% and they have either two or more open shipping tickets or a renewal due within 120 days. This week, three renewal accounts (Sevland Utilities, Vornwick Utilities, Marmark HVAC) need executive calls, four accounts with three or more open tickets (Tamwick Mining, Galbury Steelworks, Halbrook Fluid Systems, Jormark Paper Mills) need their tickets escalated, and two accounts (Tamford Food Processing, Wesmore Energy) need a shared late-delivery list. The ticket counts come from Zendesk, which has not synced successfully since 9 Nov, so those counts may be understated.

freshness.source: salesforce (simulated landing; renewals and account identity)

assumptions: As-of date is Friday 6 Nov 2026. The delivery window is the 90 days ending 6 Nov 2026, and renewals are those closing within 120 days of that date (to about 6 Mar 2027).

'Strategic' is taken from the account__is_strategic dimension. 'Late shipments' means late deliveries as the metric defines them: the carrier's delivered event arrived after the customer's requested date, or no delivery has arrived and the date has passed.
Next steps follow Torvane's playbook in the order given: renewal within 120 days first, then 3 or more open shipping tickets, otherwise the late-delivery list.
Ticket counts include tickets on look-alike duplicate accounts, as the metric definition specifies.
Renewal close dates were taken from the renewal query for accounts with a renewal in the window. Accounts with no renewal in the window show null.
caveats: Zendesk is outside its 24-hour freshness window. Its last successful sync was 9 Nov 2026 and the latest attempt failed (API rate limit). Open shipping tickets come from Zendesk, so ticket counts may be understated and the next step for several accounts could change once it syncs. Tamford and Wesmore sit at 2 tickets, one below the escalation threshold. Vornridge Water Works (on-time rate 77.8%, 1 ticket, no renewal in window) is not flagged today but would be if it gained one more ticket.
The freshness timestamps (checked 11 Nov 2026, syncs 9-11 Nov) fall after the 6 Nov as-of date. I answered as of 6 Nov per the metric definitions, but the source age relative to that date is unclear.
Delivery counts per account are small (18 to 30 deliveries over 90 days), so one or two late shipments move the rate by several points.
Delivery and renewal data are from sources inside their freshness window (carrier, SAP, Salesforce). The ticket data is the only source outside it.
Tamdale Food Processing has a renewal in the window but is not at risk (on-time rate 95.8%, 3 tickets), so it is not in the list.
